narration: TikTok just showed its plan to close the sale inside the app.
This was at Advertising Week in New York.
Buy Direct lets people purchase from the For You feed
A Shopping Assistant answers questions on sizing, shipping and stock.
Lead agents are coming to DMs too,
and TikTok's ads tools now plug into assistants like Claude.
For US advertisers, ads can now run
across nearly four hundred thousand outside apps.
The catch: most of this has no launch date yet.
So plan for it, but don't bet the quarter on it.
